verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party Incident Management doc page, so the product itself covers declaring and tracking incidents. The pack gives only the page title, though, with no detail on timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies. Community use of notebooks during incidents is a workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented incident timelines, on-call scheduling, escalation policies, detailed incident declaration/tracking workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
